setup: The owner's Octatrack MKII, OS 1.40C, RAM-booted on development twin 1e66b504 of the Modwerk release base 27c9d36f (imageSha256 is that twin's MAIN image; baseIdentity is the identity the unit reported). The module ran as a RAM trial of the package named here, the release package built by npm run octatrack:module-packages from the source revision named here. Each picture is the unit's own LCD, read over USB by the development session's png step: 128x64 at integer scale 2 (256x128), two grey levels in an 8-bit greyscale PNG, not edited. Hardware captures, not emulator ones. The panel steps were sent by the session (double tap T1, LEFT, DOWN to AMIGA; YES, NO, SRC; FUNC+SRC).
